epic.title: The door is the interface, and the spine is the job
epic.intent_and_why: Agents reach a spine only through the MCP door, and receive their work as a spine rather than as prose. The goal is a weaker agent than the one authoring the work: everything that can sit behind a tool or a check should, because prose instruction is a liability.

definition_of_done: A dispatched crew drives its own spine through the door, measured from its own call record.
A respawn resumes its lease rather than force-claiming it.
No shipped entry definition hardcodes an interpreter.
No agent-facing instruction names the engine CLI.
A crew that cannot satisfy a check has somewhere to go that is not silence.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Every merged change carries a control that reproduced its defect first, and a cold reviewer independent of the implementer re-ran that control.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: A property driven against a real spine through a real handshake, not asserted in prose.
good_enough.appetite: One implementer plus a cold reviewer per workstream, reworked until the reviewer approves.

hard_constraints: docs/agents/* edits are the human's call
never two crews in one worktree
merge and push to main only on cold-review approval plus a green suite
planning makes no direct gh or network mutation
fixed_decisions: Anything wanted for the spine is reachable through MCP; agents do not know about the CLI; anything reachable only through the CLI is a defect.
Judgment is highlighted and carried up: a greater claim requires greater review.
A crew fails up one rung at a time, to its recorded parent, never sideways and never silently.

current_wave.objective: Make the door the only interface an agent has to a spine: close the verb gap, remove the CLI from agent-facing instruction, make the spine itself the crew's job description, and give a stuck crew somewhere to go.
exit_criteria: All 18 engine verbs are reachable through mcp__spine__ tools.
A crew dispatched with a spine and no handoff document drives it to a terminal state and is recorded as succeeding.
A shipped template's gate is proven satisfiable by a real run, and the convention that satisfies it lives where the check does.
A pin that asserts a false fact is removed or corrected.
A crew that hits a check it cannot satisfy blocks, records its parent, and is reported as blocked rather than as failed or complete.
A cold reviewer independent of each implementer has approved each change.

wave_evidence.claim: A shipped template's gates are satisfiable by a real run.
wave_evidence.observed: No test in the repo had ever asked it. That absence is why a gate promising 'no unresolved blockers' shipped while checking only that some artifact arrived.

wave_evidence.claim: Commanders attach a consistent field to an implementer-result.
wave_evidence.observed: 122 real implementer-result records: 28 status=complete (23%), 33 verdict, 5 wrong-case status, the rest bespoke or absent. There is no convention.
wave_evidence.source: census re-run independently by the Admiral

wave_evidence.claim: The shipped templates carry checks that can fail.
wave_evidence.observed: validate_spine's sweep reports falsifiable-all-null on the context gate of nine role templates and an unresolved <exact test command> in two.

wave_evidence.claim: Hand-authoring a spine is reliable when the author is capable.
wave_evidence.expected: An Admiral authoring its own gates produces checks that work.
wave_evidence.observed: The Admiral hand-authored roughly ten work spines and seven review surveys this wave. Four carried checks that could not do their job: an unquoted -k selector, a probe importing a module that needs a bound spine, a call using a parameter name the signature does not have, and a population filter wrong twice. None was caught by the author first.

wave_evidence.claim: A headless crew can reach its dispatching parent directly.
wave_evidence.observed: A headless crew is on the peer graph but cannot reach a parent named by a descriptive string.

discrepancies.signal: The author of the spines is the least-checked link in the chain.
discrepancies.evidence: Four of the Admiral's own hand-written checks could not do their job, each caught downstream by a crew, a reviewer or argparse.
discrepancies.reason: The epic's thesis is that prose instruction is a liability; the same argument applies to hand-authored checks, and the wave produced the evidence for it.

discrepancies.signal: Two merged workstreams disagree about the same token.
discrepancies.evidence: B's test allowlists <exact test command> in two templates as a legitimate authoring-time fill-in slot; C1's lint reports the same two occurrences as unresolved-placeholder faults.
discrepancies.reason: A generator must pick a side, so the disagreement has to be settled before it is written rather than inherited by it.

discrepancies.signal: Nine of twelve shipped role templates open on a gate that cannot refuse anything.
discrepancies.evidence: validate_spine --sweep reports falsifiable-all-null on every role template's context gate.
discrepancies.reason: Either the context gate is a legitimate qualitative gate and the lint must say so, or the shipped templates carry the defect the lint was built to find. A generator inherits whichever answer is chosen.

discrepancies.signal: The Admiral commanded workstreams itself rather than dispatching a Commander.
discrepancies.evidence: Each workstream was right-sized as a bounded implementer-with-plan on its first pass and then grew to three review-and-rework rounds without being reconsidered.
discrepancies.reason: An Admiral practice failure, owed as an episode at closeout rather than as an issue.

discrepancies.signal: A design that depends on crew-to-crew messaging cannot be built on.
discrepancies.evidence: A headless crew cannot reach a parent named by a descriptive string.
discrepancies.reason: The durable path -- a blocked gate, a recorded parent, and a polling parent -- is the mechanism; messaging is an optimisation nothing may depend on.
